value.rationale: The exact population normalized fourth moment quantifies Gaussian departure in driven optical-trap dynamics. The full stiffness-ratio classification identifies a physically meaningful switching-rate non-Gaussianity resonance despite simultaneous monotone suppression of both raw moments; the universal contrast threshold and unique optimal rate explain when relative fluctuation-based diagnostics can behave opposite to raw fluctuation magnitudes. The claim is a sharp structural bifurcation rather than an unmotivated parameter substitution or arbitrary finite slice.
